kind: Source-reported reference assumptions plus bounded deterministic single-gamma design; no new counts, response or experimental refit

system.population: axisymmetric symmetric diagonal P(M) from SE21 Eq2.51, sigma/J fixed .2
system.feeding: none modeled; actual feeding not inferred
system.geometry: point single gamma relative to beam, unpolarized; not joint gamma-gamma/gate acceptance

convention.native_delta: higher radiative amplitude M3 / lower E2, corresponding to SE21 Eq2.42/43 and gamma normalization; not bare BM RME
convention.ordering_reason: source calls small DeltaI2 ratio E2/M3 and pureE2 approximate; Eq2.44 defines higherL/lowerL
convention.independent_operator_basis: RB67 normalized phase-defined amplitudes; t_KS(TL)=(-1)^(Ii-If+L) C*a_RB(TL), so adjacent-rank amplitude ratio reverses sign
convention.angle_unit: internal radians; source group degrees converted once

seven_angle_design.weights: chosen equal positive weights, no noise; not the experimental covariance
seven_angle_design.fit: free scale plus P2/P4, then normalize; compare omitted-P6 leakage only
seven_angle_design.acceptance: each source average angle used as point; no detector integration

validation_contract: Signed doubled-integer nuclear CG and Racah6j, no silent use of integer-only joint kernel for half spin
Source-F matrix and independent RB direct photon amplitudes must agree before interpreting M3
F0 identity, normalization for each M, parity/theta symmetry, pureE2 source reference and D/Q author-example controls
Quadrature convergence and bounded interval extrema; preserve first failure, do not fit phases or loosen tolerances to source targets
No optimization of sigma or delta to force match either table, no significance or confidence level
stop_contract: After matched-source controls, report A2/A4/A6 for each source configuration/interval and deterministic equal-weight angle truncation; retain producer/response/Cov gaps and stop free-parameter tuning.
boundaries: No full joint response/gate model or covariance
No new experimental delta/sigma/spin or mode decision

Theory/operator checks are not independent experiments
